SpecialThingFilterDef.label: repairable
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Apparel that can still be mended the normal way (its mend limit is not yet exhausted). If disabled, this storage will only accept apparel with exhausted mending — candidates for full reconstruction.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: repairable
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Weapons that can still be mended the normal way (their mend limit is not yet exhausted). If disabled, this storage will only accept weapons with exhausted mending — candidates for full reconstruction.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: mend-exhausted
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Apparel whose normal mending is exhausted (repaired to its mend limit; only full reconstruction can fix it). Disable to keep this storage for still-mendable apparel only.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: mend-exhausted
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Weapons whose normal mending is exhausted (repaired to their mend limit; only full reconstruction can fix them). Disable to keep this storage for still-mendable weapons only.
